Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Goal: get Ceres Health comfortable with Redwood for protected PHI workflows (Private deployment / BAA) and confirm plumbing for SSO/SCIM and admin controls.
- Action items we agreed on:
  1) I’ll send the IAM evidence checklist and the specific SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning docs.

Thanks —

Hi Jane —

Thanks — answers below and I’ve attached the items your team requested. If you want, we can do a 30-min handoff with your IdP engineers later this week.

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted product in 2025. For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide either our SOC 2 report (controls mapping) plus deployment-specific evidence; we’re tracking a Private-deployment Type II roadmap with a target audit window Q3 2027. I’ve attached our high-level status doc (soc2-attestation-status.pdf) showing what’s covered and expected dates.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Yes — Redwood offers a BAA for Dedicated and Private customers. For hosted pilots we can discuss a limited-scope agreement; for PHI production we require a signed BAA. Procurement/legal typically uses DocuSign. I’ve added a DocuSign link below to start the questionnaire.

3) SSO / SAML: attached saml-metadata.xml (stub). Key points: SAML 2.0 supported, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated, we support SHA-256 certs, and our EntityID is https://sso.redwood.ai/sp. If your IdP team needs the certificate in a separate file let me know and I’ll ask Aditya to export it.

4) SCIM / Provisioning: attached scim-provisioning-guide.pdf (stub). We support SCIM v2, push provisioning, and the usual attributes (userName, externalId, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], groups). We also support group-to-role mapping for RBAC.

5) RBAC / Admin Controls: Redwood provides built-in roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Application Admin, Read-only Auditor) and you can create custom roles with granular permissions. All admin activities are logged (who, what, when) and retained per contract.

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (stub); scim-provisioning-guide.pdf (stub); soc2-attestation-status.pdf (stub)

DocuSign vendor questionnaire: https://app.docusign.com/ceres-questions/DEAL-8345
Trust Center: https://trust.redwood.ai/iam

Let me know if you want to schedule the IdP handoff — I can make time Thursday or Friday PST.

Best,
Marissa
